title: The Sandwich That Cracked a Diamond Heist

sections.name: Hook
lines: aw_hook
Thieves pulled off one of the biggest diamond heists in history. Then a half-eaten sandwich gave them away.
aw_title
This is the Antwerp diamond heist.

sections.name: The vault
lines: aw_vault
Antwerp, Belgium. The world's diamond capital. Deep under the Diamond Centre sits a vault with ten layers of security.
aw_layers
Heat sensors. Motion detectors. A magnetic field on the door. And a combination lock with a hundred million possibilities.

sections.name: The plan
lines: aw_office
A man named Leonardo Notarbartolo rents an office in the building, posing as a gem dealer. For more than two years, he's a friendly face.
aw_camera
He used that access to study the vault. Years later, he even claimed the crew rehearsed on a full-size replica.

sections.name: The night
lines: aw_night
February 2003. Valentine's weekend. The crew slips into the vault, and beats the sensors one by one.
aw_boxes
By morning, more than a hundred safe deposit boxes are empty. An estimated hundred million dollars in diamonds, gold and jewels.

sections.name: The mistake
lines: aw_trash
But on the drive out, they dump a bag of rubbish in a forest beside the motorway. A local man finds it, and calls the police.
aw_sandwich
Inside, vault tapes, receipts, and a half-eaten salami sandwich. Those clues led detectives straight to the gang.

sections.name: The ending
lines: aw_caught
Notarbartolo was convicted and sentenced to ten years. But most of the diamonds have never been found.
aw_outro
Perfect plan. One sandwich. Where do you think the diamonds are? Follow for more true crime, animated.
